instructions: POST JSON payloads to /v1/verify-math ($0.01 USDC), /v1/quote-lock ($0.05 USDC), or /v1/reconcile ($0.25 USDC) on Base. Free trial first: POST /v1/trial/verify-math, /v1/trial/quote-lock, or /v1/trial/reconcile for 3 evaluation calls per client (X-Trial-Client header or client IP), no payment required. Pass rule_version="0.2.0" for the OVERPAID verdict. Stored judgments are re-readable at GET /v1/ledger/{idempotency_key} with the receipt returned at write time. Human CSV reconciler UIs: /app and /tools/reconcile.
